supabase-js v2.119.2 (MIT License, see LICENSE-supabase-js.txt)
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@supabase/supabase-js/v/2.119.2
tus-js-client v4.3.1 (MIT License, see LICENSE-tus-js-client.txt)
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/tus-js-client/v/4.3.1

These two libraries are loaded from the jsDelivr CDN with a pinned version and a
Subresource Integrity (SHA-384) hash. If a single byte differs, the browser refuses to run the file.
To update a library: change the version in the <script> tags of index.html, onboarding.html,
staff.html and student.html, compute the new hash, and add the CDN host to the CSP (already allowed).
